fomod.Name: Hit Detection Meter
fomod.Author: ApocryphaRealm
fomod.Description: When something hits you, a marker on a ring round the middle of the screen shows which way the hit came from. With Detection Meter installed the markers wear its art, at its size, on a ring just inside its own, closer to the character. Requires SKSE, Address Library and the Apocrypha Menu Framework (or SKSE Menu Framework).
